body:
**Note (other): Findings tables don't show which findings already shipped**

The status banner says 11 of 36 plans shipped, but the "All findings" tables list every finding as open, including those closed by shipped plans. Examples are REC-B6, LIB-B1, VID-B1 (all 🔴), VID-A3 and VID-A5. A reader of the table cannot tell which high findings are still open. Add a status column or a strikethrough/“fixed in #n” marker, or say that the tables are a snapshot at d36b19dd.

**Note (other): Exception reporting may send paths/stderr despite the 'no paths or error text' rule**

The plan's architecture says properties never carry paths or error text. `captureMainException(error, "screenshot-capture")` (and the catalog-refresh one at line 520) forwards the raw error. An `execFile` error message includes the command line with the temp PNG path, and may include stderr. The rule is stated for event properties only. Either say that exceptions are exempt, or scrub the message before sending.

**Note (correctness): Same-millisecond test is probabilistically flaky and doesn't pin the claim**

Test 4 mints twice with a fixed `now` and the default random suffix, but nothing is written between mints, so `hasMedia` never sees the first id. The two ids collide with probability 1/65536 and the test fails. It also doesn't prove that two finalizes in the same ms get different ids (Review Focus 1). Inject a deterministic `random` that returns different values, or write the first id's file before the second mint.

**Note (correctness): Stale poster is never refreshed on edit/overwrite unless save path rewrites it**

The freshness check in `ensureScreenshotPoster` (and its "regenerates when PNG is newer" test) is only reached from the protocol's 404 fallback. If a poster file exists but is stale, the `thumb` route serves it as is. Manual step 4 (Edit + Save, card shows updated image) therefore depends entirely on the edit/overwrite path going through `screenshotSave` and calling `writeScreenshotPoster`. The plan only wires that call after `vault.writeImage` in `screenshotSave`. Please confirm every code path that rewrites a PNG (editor overwrite, any other `writeImage` caller) goes through it. Otherwise the stale poster is served until the `?v=` token changes, and even then the old file is returned.

**Note (correctness): Capped paste still creates tags it cannot assign**

addMany calls onCreate for every valid piece before assignMany applies the per-item cap. With one slot left and a paste of `x, y, z, `, all three tags are created in the registry and only one is assigned, which leaves orphan tags. The 'caps a paste' test checks only the length of the onAssign argument, so it would not catch this. Stop resolving pieces once idsRef.current.length plus resolved.length reaches TAGS_PER_ITEM_MAX.

**Note (correctness): Bar-hidden test may pass without the fix**

The test releases the `getSources` promise and then awaits a single `Promise.resolve()` before asserting `bar.show` was not called. `displayIdForSource(...).then(...)` needs more than one microtask to run, so the assertion can run before the callback and pass even if the `barGeneration` guard is missing. Flush with `await vi.runAllTimersAsync()` (or several ticks), as the next test does, so the test fails without the guard.

**Note (correctness): Timeout path force-resets a renderer that may still be alive**

On the close/quit timeout the hub calls `forceReset()`, which under this plan aborts every writer session (and, under plan 22, releases them). The renderer may only be slow, not dead, and a slow finalize can then fail because its session is gone. The plan lists the slow `copyFile` case as a follow-up. The same race also applies to a finalize that is still running when the timeout fires, and that is worth stating in Global Constraints.

**Note (correctness): Heartbeat does not actually bound gaps to 1 s**

The heartbeat is a 1 s setInterval that only draws if `now - lastDrawAt >= 1000`. If a source frame drew at t=500 ms, the tick at t=1000 sees only 500 ms elapsed and skips, so the next draw can be up to ~2 s after the last one on a mostly static screen. That contradicts the stated 1 s bound for R1 (VFR gaps). Use a shorter tick (e.g. 250 ms) with the same >=1000 check, or reset the interval on each draw, so the plan's guarantee holds.

**Note (correctness): useTimeSelector passes a new subscribe function every render**

The planned `useSyncExternalStore((onChange) => subscribeTime(() => onChange()), ...)` creates a new subscribe closure on each render. React then unsubscribes and resubscribes on every render of the host component. This is correct but wasteful. Wrap the subscribe function in `useCallback` keyed on `subscribeTime`, or pass `subscribeTime` through a stable wrapper, before the plan is implemented.

Fixed in 494208bd: the report now says these tables are the snapshot at `d36b19dd` and points to the fix plans index, whose Shipped table lists each shipped plan, the findings it closed and its PR. Kept the tables frozen rather than adding a status column, so the report stays a record of what the audit saw.

Fixed in 494208bd: Global Constraints now say the no-paths rule covers event properties, that `captureMainException` is the existing crash-report path and forwards the raw error, and that before wiring the two new calls the implementer strips absolute paths from `error.message` in `buildExceptionProperties` (or reports an error-kind enum event instead).

Fixed in 494208bd: the test now uses a deterministic suffix sequence (aaaa, aaaa, bbbb), writes the first id's file before the second mint, and asserts the second id differs. It can no longer collide by chance, and it fails if the on-disk check is missing.

Confirmed by reading `main` at 801a362c: `screenshot-save.ts:29` is the only `vault.writeImage` caller, editor overwrite included, so the save-time poster write covers every PNG rewrite today. Fixed in 494208bd: Global Constraints state this dependency and require any new `writeImage` caller to write the poster too.

Fixed in 494208bd: `addMany` stops resolving once `idsRef.current.length + resolved.length` reaches `TAGS_PER_ITEM_MAX`, and the 'caps a paste' test now asserts `onCreate` is called once, so it fails if orphan tags are created.
Fixed in 494208bd: the test flushes with `await vi.runAllTimersAsync()` (as the next test does), with a comment that a single microtask lets it pass without the generation guard.

Fixed in 494208bd: Global Constraints now state that the close/quit timeout force-resets a renderer that may only be slow, so a finalize still in flight fails once its session is aborted. Accepted for this plan because the window is closing either way; the existing `finalizeInFlight` follow-up is the fix.
Fixed in 494208bd: the heartbeat keeps the 1 s threshold but ticks every 250 ms (`HEARTBEAT_TICK_MS`), so a gap is at most about 1.25 s. R1 now states that bound.
Fixed in 494208bd: `subscribe` is wrapped in `useCallback` keyed on `subscribeTime` and passed to `useSyncExternalStore`, so React keeps one subscription across renders.
